name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An AI research assistant that reads what real people are saying across Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News and prediction markets, then hands you a trustworthy summary of what's actually happening with a topic.
buyer: A market researcher, VC analyst, or content creator who needs a fast, credible pulse-check on a trend without spending a day manually reading forums.
business_use_cases: A VC associate runs it before a pitch meeting to get a grounded read on community sentiment about a startup's category.
A content creator uses it weekly to spot emerging topics across platforms before writing a 'what's trending' newsletter.
A brand's social team uses it to monitor real public sentiment about a product launch instead of relying on vanity metrics.

money_ideas.idea: Turn it into a paid 'trend brief' newsletter for a niche (e.g. AI tools, fintech) delivered weekly.
Offer it as a white-label research tool for agencies who bill their own clients for trend reports.

steal_this: Pick one niche (e.g. 'AI coding tools'), run this daily, and publish a free public 'what the internet is saying this week' digest to build an audience, then sell sponsorships.
